title: Arglabin regulates microglia polarization to relieve neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease.
authors: Yang, Yi; Guo, Li; Wang, Jin; Li, WenYan; Zhou, Xiaohong; Zhang, Caiqun; Han, Chenyang
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Arglabin通过靶向NF-kappaB P50调节小胶质细胞极化缓解阿尔茨海默病神经炎症，虽含分子对接但对象为药物-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Arglabin (Arg) is a derivative of parthenolide. At present, there are few reports on the pharmacological effects and targets of Arg. In this study, we aimed to explore the relationship between Arg and NF-kappaB (P50) and the intervention effects of Arg on neuroinflammation. BV2 cells were cultured in vitro. LPS/IFN-gamma was used to induce M1 polarization. After Arg intervention, the cytokine expression of M1 and M2 cell marker was detected, the expression of CD86 was detected by immunofluorescence (IF) staining, the levels of P50 and p-P50 were detected by Western blot and the expression of ROS was by DCFH-DA. AfterP50 knockout, we investigated the effect of P50 on the polarization of BV2 cells. Four-month-old APP/PS1 (AD) mice were treated with Arg by intragastric administration, followed by detection of the expression of CD86, CD206, and IBA-1 by IF staining, Finally, molecular-protein docking and Pull-down assays were used to validate the targeted binding relationship between P50 and Arg. Arg could inhibit the M1 polarization of BV2 cells, decrease the levels of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, iNOS, and IL-12, and simultaneously inhibit the expression of P50 and p-P50. P50 knockout could inhibit the M1 polarization of BV2 cells, and P50 played an important role in the polarization of BV2 cells. Molecular docking and pull-down assays revealed that Arg and P50 had a targeted binding relationship. Animal experiments showed that Arg could regulate the polarization level of M1-M2 cells, increase the proportion of M2 cells, decrease the degree of nerve injury and suppress the expression of P50 and p-P50. In this study, we found that Arg could target P50 to regulate reprogramming of BV2 cells, inhibit M1 polarization, and increase the level of M2 cells, thereby exerting a neuroprotective effect.
abstract_zh: Arglabin (Arg) 是小白菊内酯的衍生物。目前，关于Arg的药理作用及靶点的报道较少。本研究旨在探讨Arg与NF-kappaB (P50) 的关系及Arg对神经炎症的干预作用。体外培养BV2细胞，采用LPS/IFN-gamma诱导M1极化。Arg干预后，检测M1和M2细胞标志物的细胞因子表达，通过免疫荧光 (IF) 染色检测CD86表达，通过Western blot检测P50和p-P50水平，并通过DCFH-DA检测ROS表达。P50敲除后，我们研究了P50对BV2细胞极化的影响。对四个月龄的APP/PS1 (AD) 小鼠通过灌胃给予Arg治疗，随后通过IF染色检测CD86、CD206和IBA-1的表达。最后，采用分子-蛋白对接和Pull-down实验验证P50与Arg之间的靶向结合关系。Arg能够抑制BV2细胞的M1极化，降低TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6、iNOS和IL-12的水平，同时抑制P50和p-P50的表达。P50敲除能够抑制BV2细胞的M1极化，且P50在BV2细胞极化中发挥重要作用。分子对接和Pull-down实验显示，Arg与P50具有靶向结合关系。动物实验表明，Arg能够调节M1-M2细胞的极化水平，增加M2细胞比例，降低神经损伤程度，并抑制P50和p-P50的表达。本研究发现，Arg能够靶向P50调节BV2细胞的重编程，抑制M1极化，并增加M2细胞水平，从而发挥神经保护作用。
